title: First-Responder Intake Lane + Deferred-Commit Contract for High-Touch Accounts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Account teams report unpredictable SLAs for escalated feature requests from strategic customers. Engineering capacity and roadmap commitments are strained by ad-hoc VIP asks without a durable contract for scope or timelines. Goal: Create a lightweight, operational First-Responder Intake Lane that captures enriched signals, provides an immediate acknowledgment SLA, and pairs with a Deferred-Commit Contract (DCC) — a templated agreement that defines accepted deliverables, deferral window, and tradeoff credits. This ticket scopes the product-side definition, acceptance criteria, roll-out plan, and handoffs to Solutions/Support and Sales.
background: Multiple enterprise customers escalated bug+feature bundles during Q4 and Q1. We lack a consistent quick-response intake that both calms account relationships and sets clear expectations for roadmap delivery. Existing docs focus on prioritization heuristics but do not operationalize an initial acknowledgment + deferral contract flow.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Launch a First-Responder Intake template in Console for account managers with 2-minute email ack + 24-hour triage SLA
A2: Publish a Deferred-Commit Contract (DCC) template stored in Drive and available via Console 'Propose DCC' action
A3: Implement a minimal signal enrichment payload (MVP fields) accepted by PM intake API: account_tier, ARR_bucket, impact_score, requested_scope, requested_deadline, escalator_contact
A4: Rollout pilot with 5 strategic accounts, measure NPS change and expected delivery variance over 60 days
A5: Document handoff playbook to Eng, Solutions, and Sales with explicit rollback/fallback clauses
tasks: Draft DCC legal-lite template and approval checklist
Design Console intake UI (mock + copy) for first-responder lane
Spec PM Intake API MVP and wire event hooks for alerts
Coordinate pilot selection with Sales/CS and identify 5 accounts
Create metrics dashboard: ack_time, triage_time, DCC_sign_rate, pilot_satisfaction
Write rollout communication and training for Solutions/Support
